evals.name: green-baseline-registers-artifact
evals.prompt: You are running the baseline stage of run feat-x. Your input is {}. The config declares a baseline command for packages core and sdk, and both suites currently pass.
evals.expected_output: Runs the baseline script for run feat-x, replies with the JSON it printed, and finishes the stage with the baseline artifact.
expectations: Runs the script with `orchestrate skill run baseline.script --run feat-x` and no --packages flag
Waits for the command to finish rather than stopping it early
The stage output is exactly the printed { path, workspace, packages } JSON
Finishes the stage with an --artifact of type baseline with path artifacts/baseline.json
anti_expectations: Runs typecheck, lint or test commands itself instead of the baseline script
Invents or reshapes fields in the output

evals.name: red-suite-still-completes
evals.prompt: You are running the baseline stage of run feat-y. Your input is { "packages": ["core", "sdk"] }. The core suite currently has two failing tests; sdk passes.
evals.expected_output: Runs the baseline for core and sdk, finishes the stage normally with the baseline artifact, and names core as the script that exited non-zero.
expectations: Runs the resolved baseline script with `--run feat-y --packages core,sdk`
Finishes the stage as completed, with an --artifact of type baseline with path artifacts/baseline.json
Names core as the script that exited non-zero in its report
anti_expectations: Finishes the stage with --error because a suite was red
Tries to fix the failing tests
Re-runs the baseline hoping for a different result

evals.name: command-error-stops-without-editing-config
evals.prompt: You are running the baseline stage of run feat-z. Your input is {}. When you run the baseline it exits 1 and prints: CONFIG_STALE core: baseline cwd /repo/.worktrees/feat-z/pkgs/core is not a folder. Fix it in orchestrate.config.json
evals.expected_output: Stops and reports the CONFIG_STALE error as printed, leaving orchestrate.config.yaml untouched.
expectations: Reports the error text the command printed, including CONFIG_STALE and the folder it named
Ends the stage with `done --error` carrying that message, with no --artifact
Says that fixing the config is for the person to do
anti_expectations: Retries the command with different --packages or --dir options
Runs the package's tests directly as a workaround
